comment: Who is who in git, for Tools/Build/who_works_where.py and Docs/TEAM.md. Most commits are authored by Claude, so a person is found by their own commits, by the pull requests they merge, by a Claude commit they committed, and by branch prefixes they own. 'confirmed': false marks an identity inferred from history that the person has not confirmed; correct it here (any collaborator may) and run who_works_where.py map.

people.name: Garrett
people.role: Owner of bleeding-edge: reviews and merges most pull requests (vessels, tests, environment / ecology, arcade modes, impact effects). Own work: AI training, crystal hull fusion, the Regatta AI roadmap, multiplayer (MPPM) roadmap, the labs (Omni, Thresher Plant Lab).

people.name: Caleb
people.role: QA sessions (Docs/QA/RESULTS), arcade mode map and previews, card art.

people.name: Shombith
people.role: Heads tooling: the Amoebius engine, editor tools, the Claude skills (/ship and the rest) and the hooks (Shombith, 2026-10-23). Owns cloud and backend services and data (UGS). UI (Menu_Main, UI prefabs, colour tokens, Codex), multiplayer scenes; drives the Amoebius ENGINE milestones (Port/src/CosmicShore.Engine, Player, tests) and merges those pull requests.

people.name: Yash
people.role: Bug Hunt, party / multiplayer (UGS), diagnostics (redlog), leaderboards; the Vessel Studio and the Amoebius LAUNCHER / studio server / artifact library.

people.name: aradia1
people.role: Audio and haptics (FMOD project, drift / boost sounds), vessel feel tuning.

people.name: studyholic
people.role: Skim Race AI hand-play runs, prism animation docs. Which collaborator's machine this is is not known: confirm here.

people.name: Grok Bot
people.role: An automated agent (not a person). Its commits reached bleeding-edge through Yash's merge #1078; whose it is is not confirmed.

unattributed_prefixes.claude/: a Claude Code session; the person is the one who merges or pushes it
unattributed_prefixes.cece/: a Claude Code session; merged mostly by Garrett, sometimes Shombith
